title: What is new in prototype v2
intro: Six stops, about two minutes. Each stop opens a screen and highlights one new feature. Every number is sample data.
outro: Copy your notes and send them to your delivery lead. We turn each note into a requirement change before the next version.

steps.title: Today at a glance
steps.body: First-time fix rate, jobs at risk of missing their SLA, and money ready to invoice, on one row.

steps.title: Dispatch assistant
steps.body: Suggests the nearest qualified technician. A dispatcher accepts or changes every suggestion.

steps.title: Jobs with live status
steps.body: Every job shows its technician and status. Suggested assignments wait for a person.

steps.title: Invoice drafts
steps.body: Completed jobs become invoice drafts. A draft that needs a person says why.

steps.title: Customer view
steps.body: Customers see reports, photos and invoices, and sign off completed work.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.body: Which of these would you use every day? Add a note, then press Finish to copy all your notes.
